list: The official 55 trophies, verified 2026-11-19 against Exophase and PSNProfiles (names, descriptions and grades agree on both; PSN targets from PSNProfiles; hidden set from GTA Zone, 28 hidden: 27 bronze + 1 gold). No name, description or grade in the starter list needed correcting.

exophase.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)

psnprofiles.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: The platinum. It pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours — there is no separate task, no online requirement and no DLC involved. Work the list in roadmap order and this one takes care of itself.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1, and it pops at the end of the mission. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Unmissable. It pops when Chapter 1 ends — PowerPyx places the pop at the start of the Chapter 2 opener, What's in the Bag? Just keep playing the story.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Unmissable. Awarded for finishing Chapter 2; PowerPyx has it popping as the Chapter 3 opener, Welcome to Vice City, begins.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Unmissable. Finish Chapter 3; PowerPyx says it lands after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Unmissable. Finish Chapter 4; PowerPyx places the pop at the end of the Chapter 4 finale mission, Starting From Zero.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Unmissable gold for finishing the story's final mission. PowerPyx ties it to the finale mission Starting From Zero, while other lists describe it as the Chapter 5 finale. Either way it pops at the credits — just finish the story.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Unmissable. It pops during the Chapter 2 story mission Breakfast Run. No preparation needed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Unmissable. It pops during The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 story mission.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Unmissable. It pops during Child's Play, a Chapter 4 story mission.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Unmissable. It pops during Headliners, a Chapter 4 story mission.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Unmissable. It pops during VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 story mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Unmissable. It pops during Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 story mission per PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The gold for 100% completion — the hardest trophy on the list and the reason the platinum takes about 200 hours. The checklist unlocks under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion after the story, but progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on it is missable. The thresholds are lenient: PowerPyx puts it near 60% true completion — 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges. Do optional missions as they appear and work the checklist after the credits.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts (300 are needed for 100%). Four kinds count: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — mix them freely and pick the easiest. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest. Track progress by region in Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and completed stunts stay marked on the map.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt. Check Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities to see which types you have done. Most come up naturally while working on other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. PowerPyx has a per-range guide; the medals are not too hard, and the challenges feed the 100% checklist, so work them alongside One Last Thing.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations (42 races exist in total; all 42 are needed for 100%). One win per location is enough for the trophy. PowerPyx maps all 14 spots.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race locations. Winning the same race twice does not count, so keep moving to new spots. PowerPyx lists all 40 locations.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, when you have met Cal, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple map icon. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in a challenge. He contacts you first — just answer the text and go fish.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game (called Video Games in-game). There are four: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. Finishing all levels of any one game once is enough — you do not need to beat every challenge in it.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline, Lucia-only, starts in Chapter 3 when Andy calls and texts her address in Belville. Finish her five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops on the last one. The quests stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline starts in Chapter 1, after the mission Island Dreams: he calls, then shows as a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — find the chests with the metal detector and bring them back. Kenton goes quiet for a stretch of the story but returns in Chapters 2 to 3, so nothing here is missable. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Finish his five jobs — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops on the last. All of it stays open after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers around Leonida — but only certain questlines count. PowerPyx confirms Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. They all stay available in free roam after the story, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 high-end sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City — scan cars with the WAiNK app to check the list, steal them anywhere, and drive them back in good condition for more pay. Sports cars cluster around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach hotels. It stays open after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline, Jason-only, opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers point to Synthetic Labs in Vice City — destroy the labs in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest, then Tyrone hands you Spin On This to shut them down for good. Finish that second quest and the trophy pops. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE potentially missable trophy — the only one on the list. Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; you can meditate as both Jason and Lucia at each spot, which counts double. The catch: the first meditation happens at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — after the Down to Earth mission, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept. It vanishes after Chapter 1, and it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it to be safe. Track spots under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. For 100% you only need 15 of 18, so this cannot cost you A Long Road.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting questline, Jason-only, opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts you about meeting him in Lummox County. His first quest, Veteran Hunted, hands you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69; after that he marks hunting spots on the map and you bring him the animals he asks for. It stays open after the story. PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed exactly which animal pops the trophy, so work the whole questline.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. PowerPyx maps all 18 set locations; you only need any three, so pick the sets whose cards cluster closest together.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app (hold Up, then R1 on a landmark). There are far more than 100: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags. Any mix counts, so scan whatever you pass.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges (70 are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way). Check Progress, then Challenges to see what is done — most complete naturally while chasing other trophies. Leave this for late, then pick the easiest remaining ones.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, lose a 4-star wanted level and escape the heat. Partner play unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break; call your partner with Right plus Triangle. Build 4 stars by causing chaos, then escape the red heat zone — a fast sports bike through traffic works, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is an easy escape route. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 bank-vault missions, which always bring 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Call your partner (Right plus Triangle), then hit three robbery targets in a row while the police stay on you — keep the flashing wanted level, do not let it drop. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well once Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs unlock them; loot a couple of items per store and crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after the third shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app (hold Up to open it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive it. A busy road gives you dozens in minutes. You need 200 of 277 base models for 100%, so this pops on the way. Check totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 plus R3 while aiming; it slows time and marks weak spots, but only lasts a few seconds. Buff your focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline, wear body armor, and line up a group — gang-operation enemies work best; it does not seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians. An accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556 helps. Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier late in the game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA — not one parked on the airfield, it must be connected to a boarding bridge. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the bridge, get in, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly about 1 km away from the airport and the trophy pops (slightly delayed).
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Tanks sit in the south of the base — drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot enemies until the trophy pops. Expect a 3-star wanted level for the trouble.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Yasmani's Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun and marks jewelry robberies with green icons. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it (kicking trips the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room, and loot the safe. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. Vaults open with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner — one of you carries a second cash bag (hold Right to hand it off). After that mission, Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 once you have done his earlier jobs. Every vault robbery brings a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast bike. You need all 8 for 100%, so this pops on the way.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults counts — tailing the truck to a bank and robbing the vault qualifies. Earlier method: find an armored truck near a bank in Vice City, block it, stick a bomb on the back door and blow it open — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. Either way the trophy only pops once you escape the red heat radius.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map of Leonida — all 52 regions. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every blacked-out patch until the whole map is visible. PowerPyx has a fast-unfogging route and plane pick.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang is enough for the trophy, but 100% wants all 39. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically through the story. Track per-gang progress under Progress, then Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — PowerPyx and GTA Zone both list this one as unknown as of launch, with no verified trigger. Do not chase it blind: the likeliest read is a bar or venue interaction on Ocean Beach, and the trigger will be confirmed by the guide community soon. Check the linked guides for updates.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. The description points to smashing out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — GTA Zone's current guess is driving a car out through the showroom window, but neither PowerPyx nor GTABase has pinned it down. Treat any showroom stunt as a guess until a guide verifies it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the gang operations. It opens during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Bring sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation to blow the safe. The three items: a luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item — and if you miss one, the robbery icon respawns later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia, then Strength (heart icon). It only opens once you can switch between both characters, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Buy a gym membership and always train together — call your partner with Right plus Triangle, and while one works out the other trains too, doubling progress. Gyms are marked under Map, then Activities.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Turn on the notifications first (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile = On) — a small demon face appears whenever an action counts. Stealthy objectives and clean escapes push you Professional; hurting enemies without killing them is Hardened; killing is Violent; mass cop and civilian kills is Psycho; keep going and you hit Irredeemable, which is permanent and makes cops shoot on sight — avoid it. It fills passively through robberies and fights, so leave it for last and farm the remainder only if needed.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. PowerPyx believes it is tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, and the description — Second time's the charm — suggests a second attempt at something that first goes wrong. No verified trigger exists yet, so do not grind for it blind; check the linked guides as the community cracks it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. PowerPyx believes it comes from a UFO questline, and the description (What the hell just happened?) points to a strange encounter rather than a grind. No verified trigger exists yet — keep it on the watch list and check the linked guides for updates.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. PowerPyx's current belief is that it comes from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — a melee drive-by, as the name suggests. No verified trigger exists yet, so treat that as a lead, not a fact, and check the linked guides for updates.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts — a running total, not one delivery. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single job, so this fills naturally during the robbery grind.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — a running total. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest burn since they cost the most. It fills passively while you play; if you are close at the end, buy a few expensive mods.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (about $160,000 in total). They go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — buy through the app. The 4 story garages do not count. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 to 4, are the quickest way to fund them.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses; it lets you register stolen cars and have them delivered anywhere. Each garage adds parking spots, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes). Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then Respray and Register in his garage. Early on he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register Standard Tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
